say:0:1510205001:0.text: Encircled by the hollow gazes of beastly skulls, the altar rests in silent waters. Its timeworn stones were marred by dark, red stains.
say:0:1510205001:0.source_cn: 被野兽头骨簇拥着的祭台安静躺在水中，石缝中有许多红褐色...

say:1:1510205002:0.text: You recognize the signs. Similar sacrifices have been held here more than once.
say:1:1510205002:0.source_cn: 你知道那是什么，看来类似的祭祀举行过不止一次。

say:2:1510205003:0.text: You don't recall seeing such rituals in Mauler lands. <style="highlight">This feels more ancient, more barbaric, almost primordial in its cruel simplicity.</style>
say:2:1510205003:0.source_cn: 仔细回忆，你从未在蛮血的领地见过类似的活祭习俗。<st...

say:3:1510205004:1.text: However, your memory isn't always reliable.
say:3:1510205004:1.source_cn: 不过你也知道，自己的记忆并不可信。
